description: This file defines the PerformanceTracker class, an entity representing performance tracking records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for tracking details, relationships to Employee entities, and methods for accessing and modifying these properties, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: PerformanceTracker
classes.description: An entity class representing a performance tracking record, with properties for tracker name, dates, status, related employees, and reviewers, mapped to a database table via Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance tracker record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the performance tracker record.

methods.name: getTrackerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setTrackerName
methods.description: Sets the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the performance tracker was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the performance tracker was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the performance tracker was last modified.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the modified date of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this performance tracker.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this performance tracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Returns the collection of reviewers for this performance tracker.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Sets the collection of reviewers for this performance tracker.

methods.name: getAddedBy
methods.description: Returns the Employee who added this performance tracker.

methods.name: setAddedBy
methods.description: Sets the Employee who added this performance tracker.
